features: PREMIUM MATTE FINISH & MODERN DESIGN: Upgrade your home entertainment with the TRONICA Ace 4, featuring a sleek 2026 premium matte finish that resists fingerprints and complements modern TV setups. Its stylish design fits perfectly in living rooms, bedrooms, and media centers while adding a touch of sophistication to your interiors.

VERSATILE 5-IN-1 CONNECTIVITY: Stream music and movies your way with lag-free Bluetooth for smartphones, tablets, and laptops. Enjoy plug-and-play support via USB pendrives, SD cards, FM radio, and AUX input for Smart TVs, PCs, or gaming consoles, ensuring seamless multimedia playback.

40W RMS CINEMATIC SURROUND SOUND: Immerse yourself in true 5.1 channel surround sound powered by a 4-inch subwoofer and 5 high-fidelity satellite speakers. Enjoy crisp trebles, balanced mids, and deep bass, creating a theater-like audio experience for movies, music, gaming, and parties.

CUSTOMIZED AUDIO WITH PRESET EQUALIZER MODES: Tailor your sound experience with 4 preset equalizer modes, optimizing output for different content types. Switch seamlessly between music, movies, gaming, and vocal modes to achieve the perfect tone, clarity, and dynamic audio for any scenario.

MULTIMEDIA ENTERTAINMENT HUB FOR HOME & PARTIES: This Bluetooth home theater system doubles as an all-in-one entertainment hub. Perfect for movies, music streaming, gaming, karaoke, or small parties, it delivers powerful sound, rich bass, and immersive audio for every indoor gathering or personal media setup.
